CLOSEOUT — OPENINGS PACKAGE
Northgate Metals supplied 10 steel fire doors, 10 closer sets, and 6 aluminum awning windows, then installed and aligned all doors and windows as one completed package for PHP 485,000. One lot; delivery and unloading included.

Door installation covers the fire doors and closer sets. Window installation covers the aluminum windows. Two-year workmanship warranty. Accounting note: release retention next week.
